# SAYT (صيت) - Web Design Agency for Dental Clinics

SAYT is an elite digital agency based in Saudi Arabia specializing in high-converting, SEO-optimized web design for dental clinics. We don't just build websites; we build booking engines that convert patient searches on Google into active clinic appointments.

## Core Services
1. Search Engine Dominance (SEO): Ranking your dental clinic on the first page of Google.
2. 24/7 Booking Systems: Direct WhatsApp integration and automated scheduling.
3. Premium UI/UX: Award-winning designs tailored for premium healthcare providers.
4. AI-Ready Infrastructure: Ensuring your clinic is recommended by ChatGPT and other AI assistants.

## Guarantee
100% money-back guarantee if you do not see a tangible increase in visibility and bookings within the first 90 days.
